gaps.sentence: The new law comes ___ force next month.
gaps.explanation: 'come into force' = officially start to apply.

gaps.sentence: By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: ___ from being annoyed, she was delighted.
gaps.explanation: 'far from + adjective' = not at all: Far from being annoyed…

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ laughing at his accent.
No matter how hard he pulled, he ___ open the drawer.
It was not ___ midnight that the results were announced.
The meeting has been ___ forward to Monday.
gaps.explanation: 'bring forward' = move to an earlier time (opposite of put off).
